_note: Hard limits used by check_lengths.py. 'verified' is false where sources disagreed or no official figure was found in October 2026; confirm in the platform's own composer and update this file.

x.notes: 280 is the standard (non-Premium) limit. Each tweet in a thread is checked separately.

instagram.notes: Caption limit 2,200 is from Meta's API docs. Hashtag cap: Instagram Help Center reportedly says 5; older sources say 30. Using 5.

facebook.notes: No practical platform limit; 5,000 is a house cap so posts stay readable.

google_business_profile.notes: 1,500 is from a non-official source. Check in the Business Profile post composer. No phone numbers in the text: use the button instead.

tiktok.notes: Sources say 2,200 (Direct Post API) or 4,000 (app). Using the lower figure. Script is a house cap for about 60 seconds of speech.
